title: OpenRig runs Claude Code and Codex as one multi-agent system
friendlyTitle: OpenRig lets Claude Code and Codex work together
summary: OpenRig is an Apache-2.0 TypeScript harness that coordinates Claude Code and Codex within a shared multi-agent workflow. The repository has more than 400 stars, around 3,000 commits and fresh activity during the collection window.
friendlySummary: OpenRig is an open-source tool that coordinates Claude Code and Codex as a team. It keeps shared progress and can notify a person when attention is needed.
whyItMatters: Developers can use it to experiment with assigning different roles to separate coding agents while preserving shared mission progress and human notifications. It is most relevant when one coding session has become too large for a single agent to manage cleanly.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test larger coding jobs where different agents plan, build or review separate parts under human supervision.
